notes.title: Meet the second part of bear game
notes.content:
Meet 2 the second part of the  bear game. It is "Bear 2 Stalingrad". The game has moved to a new engine. Enemy models and animations has been improved.

Bear 2 Stalingrad - is the continuation of the famous bestseller "BEARS, VODKA, BALALAIKA!"

This time, Motherland sent you to fight vs Nazi forces in the ruins of the snowy Stalingrad. Kill enemies and conquer trophy weapons to get the maximum chance to survive until the next round. Survival mode is a wave based no-win scenario, test your skills with the odds increasingly stacked against you.

Add to your wishlists [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232130/Bear_2_Stalingrad/]Bear 2 Stalingrad[/url]
